The original web pages for the ontologies have been archived in the Wayback Machine using the web-archiving tool Archive-it. The links to the archived pages are provided below.

These are the ontologies developed by the Canadian Writing Research Collaboratory. The separate ontologies are:

  • CWRC ontology - the main ontology of the Canadian Writing Research Collaboratory
  • CWRC genre ontology - ontology used by the Canadian Writing Research Collaboratory to assign Literary Genres to different documents
  • Illnesses and injuries ontology - illnesses and injury classification based on IDC

    • The ontologies can be used in conjunction with the RDF data found in the dataset The Orlando British Women's Writing Dataset Release 1: Biography and Bibliography.
